calculation.expression: -((log(close/close.shift(40))-cross_sectional_median(log(close/close.shift(40))))/downside_volatility_40), activated when cross_sectional_daily_return_dispersion exceeds its trailing_120d median, then lagged 1 day
calculation.description: Cross-asset relative 40-session shocks are reversed and scaled by 40-session downside volatility. The signal is active only in elevated cross-sectional dispersion regimes; total volatility is used when downside volatility is unavailable.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in 2020-2025 (IC -0.103641 and -0.076572) and positive in 2026-2032, with IC 0.032005 in 2026-2028, 0.067927 in 2029-2030, and 0.062539 in 2031-2032. Interpret uncertainty conservatively due to the 15-asset cross-section.
